videos.title: Total Cost
videos.description_html:
The estimated total cost is PKR 12–15 lakh, depending on your IELTS score. The package includes:

  • University-related fees
  • Visa fees
  • Six months of dormitory accommodation

If you achieve a good score in IELTS or TOEFL, the flight ticket may also be included.

The higher your English proficiency score, the lower your overall expenses are likely to be.

videos.title: Korean Embassy New Notice for Pakistani Students about Visa Review
How to Avoid Paying a Consultation Fee

kuac_note: Some universities accept applications directly. Others hand their admission process to an authorised Korean company. At those universities, the company handles your admission whether you apply yourself or through an agent. If you apply through the university's authorised company yourself, you save the fee you would otherwise pay a consultant or agent.
bank_note: This is the embassy requirement. Each university also sets its own requirements, so check its listing.
